description: Election Commission - Presidential Election, 2019 :  35 Applicants List
reasoning: This gazette content is a formal notice under Section 21 of the Presidential Elections Act, announcing that the election for the office of President is contested, specifying the polling date and time, and providing the official schedule of candidates, their symbols, and the parties/electors nominating them. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes, specifically the announcement of a presidential election and candidate nominations.
